responsibility: Implements the RISC-V common option and ISA-string subsystem. This file owns parsing of -march strings into a structured subset list with ordered standard, supervisor, hypervisor, Z, and X extensions; applies implied extensions and spec-version rules; maps parsed extensions onto gcc_options flag fields; validates -mcpu names against the CPU table; and provides driver helpers that expand canonical -march and default -mtune values from -mcpu selections. It is the normalization layer that turns textual RISC-V architecture descriptions into stable internal feature state and canonical arch strings for the backend and driver.
